messages.text:
Hi HeliumDeploy team, please forward this through to the owner.

So I was on your Bitfortun BS-4 product page just now and I think you'd see a huge improvement in conversion rate with a few changes. We applied the exact same concepts to another Shopify brand and their conversion rate on their product pages went up to 6.45%.

Would you be opposed to hearing those concepts?

Thanks,
Marti

--

Marti C.
Founder | Fuelerate

Note to the team: This is a sales pitch to us, not a customer question. No tools needed; just a short polite reply. Hi Marti, Thanks for reaching out, and for taking the time to look at our BS-4 page. Conversion work on the storefront isn't something I handle, and we're not looking to take on an o…

Hi Sarah,

Appreciate you sending this on to Georges.

For G., I'm Marti, the founder of Fuelerate. The 6.45% in my first email
came from a shampoo bar brand. With miners from $250 to $1,600, conversion rate
alone can mislead, so we judge every change on revenue per visitor, meaning what
each visitor is worth to the store.

The first concept is opening the BS-4 page on the same promise as the ad. The ad
sells 18 terahash from one outlet on about 300 watts, and a page that leads with
anything else loses people who clicked for that.

The second is answering the last doubts right beside the buy button. The honest
answer the Magic Miner 40T page gives on whether it pays for itself is that kind
of answer, and shipping and returns belong next to it.

We did this kind of work for Grill Advantage, where orders run over $1,000, and
their revenue went from $132K to $327K a month on nearly flat traffic.

If Georges wants to see the rest on his own pages, could he do Wednesday at 10am
or Thursday at 11:30am ET?

Thanks,
Marti

--

Marti C.
Founder | Fuelerate
Handed to the team · Booking a meeting and deciding on an outside agency is Georges' call, not someth

Hi Marti,

Thanks for laying it out, that's a clearer pitch than most.

I've put your message and the two proposed times in front of Georges. He's the one who decides on the site and on any outside help, so the meeting is his call rather than mine. He picks this up today from 10am ET and will reply to you here either way.

One thing worth knowing before any call: our product pages carry the ship date and VAT line per region, which is why they read differently from a straight consumer page. Worth factoring into whatever you show him.

Best,
Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

Thanks for putting it in front of Georges, Sarah.

Good to know about the ship date and VAT line per region. Those answer what
people ask right before they buy, so they'd stay next to the buy button in
anything we show him.

If he wants a look before he replies, the Grill Advantage case study
[https://www.fuelerate.com/case-study-grill-advantage] has the full story on the
store I mentioned, where orders run over $1,000.

Thanks,
Marti
